type.prompt: Fix issue #1: In scripts/attach_session.sh, when the user selects a session name via fzf that does not exist (no matching OpenClaw session), the popup closes and returns to terminal. Instead, it should prompt the user to create a new session with that name. Implementation: after SELECTED is set (line ~30), check if the session exists by running get_sessions.sh and grepping. If it does NOT exist, use tmux command-prompt or display-menu to ask "Session not found. Create it? (y/n)". If yes, call new_session.sh with the name. If no, display a message and exit. Keep the same pane/window mode. Update README if behavior changes. Branch: fix/issue-1-attach-session. Closes #1.
